description: This source file contains test code for the VoicePushToTalk class/module, specifically testing delta computation and attributed color comparisons in scenarios related to voice push-to-talk functionality.

classes.name: VoicePushToTalkTests
classes.description: A struct defining test cases for VoicePushToTalk functionality, including delta computation and color attribute comparisons.

methods.name: delta trims committed prefix
methods.description: Tests the _testDelta function to ensure it properly trims the committed prefix from the current speech.

methods.name: delta falls back when prefix differs
methods.description: Tests the _testDelta function's fallback behavior when the committed prefix does not match the start of current speech.

methods.name: attributed colors differ when not final
methods.description: Checks that attributed colors differ when the isFinal flag is false, indicating non-finalized speech segments.

methods.name: attributed colors match when final
methods.description: Verifies that attributed colors are equal when isFinal is true, indicating a finalized speech segment.
